channel.title: Business Directories — Petro Hrys
channel.description: Manually verified business directory research from PetroHrys.com.

item.title: Credit Union Locator
item.description: The National Credit Union Administration publishes a public search over federally insured credit unions. Its own site presents the locator search and a companion research view over the same data, where a credit union’s call reports can be downloaded and financial performance reports requested.

item.title: FCC Public Inspection Files
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission’s online public inspection file system for broadcast stations, cable systems, direct broadcast satellite providers and satellite radio licensees. It publishes the disclosures those entities are required to keep — political time, quarterly issues and programs lists, ownership data and pending applications — and it is a disclosure system, not a licence register.

item.title: Company database
item.description: The BaFin company database is the German financial supervisor’s searchable record of the undertakings it supervises. It covers credit institutions, leasing and factoring institutions, financial services institutions, capital management companies and further supervised categories, and carries the date its data was last updated.

item.title: Official Nationwide Register of Lawyers
item.description: The official nationwide directory of lawyers admitted in Germany, operated by the Bundesrechtsanwaltskammer over the registers of the regional bars. It answers one question — whether a person is admitted to practise as a Rechtsanwalt in Germany — and admission is required to practise, not merely to use the title.

item.title: Professional Register / Statutory Auditor Register
item.description: The professional register of German public auditors and audit firms, kept by the Wirtschaftsprüferkammer under section 37 of the Public Accountant Act. The same register also discharges the statutory auditor register required by the EU Audit Directive, so one system serves both purposes.

item.title: Official Nationwide Register of Patent Attorneys
item.description: The official nationwide directory of patent attorneys admitted in Germany, kept by the Patentanwaltskammer. It covers individual patent attorneys, in-house patent attorneys and professional practice companies, and admission is required to practise rather than only to use the title.

item.title: Official Register of Tax Advisers
item.description: The official nationwide register of German tax advisers, tax agents and tax advisory practice companies, kept by the Bundessteuerberaterkammer under section 86b of the Tax Advisory Act. It records who is entitled to give unrestricted assistance in tax matters in Germany.

item.title: Register of Persons Authorised for Temporary and Occasional Assistance in Tax Matters
item.description: The statutory register of service providers from other EU or EEA states or Switzerland who are authorised to give temporary and occasional assistance in tax matters in Germany, kept by the Bundessteuerberaterkammer under section 3b of the Tax Advisory Act.

item.title: Register of Persons with Partial Authorisation in Tax Matters
item.description: The statutory register of persons holding partial authorisation to give restricted commercial assistance in tax matters in Germany on the basis of a professional qualification obtained in the EU, EEA or Switzerland, kept by the Bundessteuerberaterkammer under section 3g of the Tax Advisory Act.

item.title: Directory of Notified Undertakings
item.description: The German directory of undertakings that have notified the Federal Network Agency under section 5 of the Telecommunications Act. It is a statutory publication rather than a searchable register: the agency publishes it periodically as a spreadsheet giving each undertaking’s name, address and a short description of the notified activity.

item.title: Directory of Postal Service Providers
item.description: The German directory of postal service providers, kept by the Federal Network Agency. Entry is constitutive rather than declaratory: since 18 July 2024 postal services may be provided only by entered providers, and a provider may subcontract only to another entered provider. It is a different legal act from the agency’s telecommunications notification directory, which it sits alongside.

item.title: Yellow Pages Germany
item.description: The German Yellow Pages business directory. A basic entry is free and is submitted through the platform’s own entry service, after which it is passed to the regionally responsible Gelbe Seiten publisher for editorial review — so an entry is requested rather than published directly.

item.title: The Telephone Book
item.description: The German national telephone and business directory. A basic business entry is free and is created through the platform’s own Firmeneintrag service, which is separate from the entry services of the other German directories it links to.

item.title: 11880.com
item.description: A German business directory operated by 11880 Solutions AG, successor to the former telephone directory enquiry company. A basic company entry is free, and company profiles carry customer ratings.

item.title: Who Supplies What
item.description: A German-language B2B supplier marketplace covering the DACH region. Suppliers create a company profile and upload product data to be found by professional buyers, which makes it a procurement discovery platform rather than a local business directory.

item.title: The Register of Architects
item.description: The Architects Register is the statutory register of architects in the United Kingdom, kept by the Architects Registration Board. Registration is required to use the title “architect”; it is not a licence to carry out architectural work, which is not reserved by law.

item.title: RegCheck
item.description: RegCheck searches the Engineering Council Register, which records the individuals entitled to use the professional titles CEng, IEng, EngTech and ICTTech. Those titles are protected under the council’s Royal Charter; engineering practice itself is not reserved by law, so registration is not a licence to work as an engineer.

item.title: The Register
item.description: IPReg publishes the register of patent attorneys, trade mark attorneys and the firms through which they practise in the United Kingdom. One search covers both professions and both individuals and firms; the professions are regulated separately but are not presented as separate public registers.

item.title: Register of Financial Agents
item.description: REGAFI is the French register of financial firms authorised to operate in France, published by the prudential supervisor. It is served from one portal together with REFASSU, the corresponding insurance register, so a single search surface covers both populations.

item.title: Single register of insurance, banking and finance intermediaries
item.description: ORIAS keeps the French official register of insurance, banking and finance intermediaries. Registration on it is compulsory, and the body that keeps it operates under the supervision of the Treasury directorate of the economy ministry.

item.title: Roll of the Order of Architects
item.description: The roll of the French Order of Architects, kept and continuously updated by the regional councils of the Order. Entry on the roll is required to use the title of architect and to carry out the design work reserved to the profession, and the roll distinguishes architects entitled to design work from those registered for other activities.

item.title: Directory of Chartered Accountants
item.description: The directory of French chartered accountants published by the Order of Chartered Accountants. Its stated purpose is to verify that a professional entrusted with accounting work is an expert-comptable entered on the roll of the Order, which is required because the profession holds an exclusive prerogative over accountancy engagements.

item.title: Directory of Industrial Property Attorneys
item.description: The directory of French industrial property attorneys published by the INPI, the national industrial property institute. The title of conseil en propriété industrielle is regulated and the list is held by the state institute rather than by the profession’s own trade body.

item.title: Official Directory of Notaries
item.description: The official directory of French notaries, published by the notarial profession’s national body. French notaries are public officers appointed to an office, so the directory records who holds a notarial office rather than who has chosen to join a scheme.

item.title: Register of entities
item.description: The Bank of Spain publishes an online register of the entities it supervises. The bank links to it from its own supervised-entities pages under the name Registro on-line de entidades.

item.title: Register of agents
item.description: The Bank of Spain publishes a separate register of agents acting for currency-exchange and transfer-management establishments and of agents of credit institutions. It is a different population from the bank’s register of supervised entities.

item.title: Official Register of Auditors
item.description: The Spanish official register of auditors and audit firms, kept by the Institute of Accounting and Account Auditing, the state audit regulator. It covers individual auditors, audit firms and third-country auditors, and sanctions entered in the register are published alongside it.

item.title: Register of Electronic Communications Network and Service Operators
item.description: The Spanish register of operators of electronic communications networks and services, kept by the CNMC. Entry follows a prior notification under article 6.2 of the General Telecommunications Act; operators must also notify cessation and must confirm every three years that they intend to continue.

item.title: Numbering Register
item.description: The Spanish numbering register, kept by the CNMC, which grants rights of use over the public numbering resources in the national numbering plans under article 30.5 of the General Telecommunications Act. It also administers signalling point codes and mobile network codes assigned to Spain by the ITU.

item.title: Supervisory registers and lists
item.description: Banca d’Italia publishes the supervisory registers and lists of banks and other financial intermediaries. It states that publication discharges the public-information duties imposed by the Italian banking and financial consolidated acts, and the published data extends beyond the registers themselves to registration and cancellation dates, activities and branches.

item.title: National Roll of Chartered Accountants and Accounting Experts
item.description: The national roll of Italian chartered accountants and accounting experts, published by the national council over the rolls kept by the territorial Ordini. It searches individual members, professional companies and declared services from one roll.

item.title: Single Electronic Professional Roll of Notaries
item.description: The single electronic professional roll of Italian notaries, published by the National Council of Notaries under article 3 of Presidential Decree 137 of 7 August 2012. The territorial Ordini and the notaries themselves enter the data; the national council states that it cannot alter it.

item.title: Money Services Business Registry
item.description: The Money Services Business Registry is the searchable record of businesses registered with Canada’s financial intelligence unit before they may operate as money services businesses. The agency states that registration does not indicate endorsement or licensing, only that a business has satisfied the legal requirements to register.

item.title: List of Registered Telecommunications Providers
item.description: The Canadian Radio-television and Telecommunications Commission’s list of organisations registered to offer telecommunications services in Canada. Registration is mandatory before an organisation may offer service and is free; it is a registration rather than a licence, and carrying traffic internationally requires a separate BITS licence.

item.title: Lists of regulated and registered financial market entities
item.description: The Czech National Bank publishes a single application over its lists of regulated and registered financial market entities. It offers direct search, the underlying basic lists, and entity counts and time series over the same data.

item.title: Search for advocates and trainee advocates
item.description: The Czech Bar Association publishes the search over its register of advocates and trainee advocates. Entry in the register is required to practise as an advocate in Czechia, so the search verifies a reserved professional status rather than membership of a voluntary body.

item.title: List of notaries
item.description: The Notarial Chamber of the Czech Republic publishes the list of Czech notaries. A notary holds a state-conferred office rather than an ordinary business licence, and the list identifies who currently holds one.

item.title: List of authorised architects
item.description: The Czech Chamber of Architects publishes the list of authorised architects. Authorisation is required to carry out selected activities in construction reserved to authorised persons, so it is an authorisation to act rather than only a protected title.

item.title: Selections from the list of authorised engineers and technicians
item.description: The Czech Chamber of Chartered Engineers and Technicians in Construction publishes selections from its list of authorised engineers and technicians. Authorisation is required to carry out selected activities in construction reserved to authorised persons.

item.title: Register of Undertakings in Electronic Communications
item.description: The Czech register of undertakings in electronic communications, kept by the Czech Telecommunication Office. Entry follows a notification under section 13 of the Electronic Communications Act under the general authorisation regime — it is not a licence — and the register deliberately retains undertakings whose activity has ended.

item.title: Allocated Numbers and Codes
item.description: The Czech register of allocated telephone numbers and codes, kept by the Czech Telecommunication Office. Allocation is an individual right granted to an undertaking, which is a different legal act from the notification that puts an undertaking on the operator register, and the database can show the full history of holders of a given number.

item.title: Portal of Granted Individual Spectrum Authorisations and Assignments
item.description: The Czech database of individual radio spectrum authorisations and assignments, kept by the Czech Telecommunication Office. Unlike the operator register, spectrum is granted individually, and the database covers licensees who are not telecommunications undertakings at all, including amateur, aeronautical and maritime radio.

item.title: Register of Postal Service Operators
item.description: The Czech register of postal service operators, kept by the same regulator that supervises electronic communications. It is included here because the Czech Telecommunication Office officially combines telecommunications and postal supervision, and it records which specific postal services each operator is entitled to provide.

item.title: Companies.cz
item.description: The business catalogue operated by Seznam.cz, the Czech search company. Registration is free, a business can add a company that is not yet listed, and company profiles carry ratings — which makes it the default Czech local citation.

item.title: Yellow Pages Czechia
item.description: The Czech Yellow Pages catalogue, operated by Mediatel. Adding a company requires signing in first, and the catalogue reports over 823,000 business contacts with profiles carrying contacts, a map and reviews.

item.title: Entity search
item.description: The Polish Financial Supervision Authority publishes a search over the entities it supervises, with category filters and an option to include entities that have been struck off. The authority states on the search page itself that it does not cover every register it keeps.

item.title: List of Legal Advisers
item.description: The national list of Polish legal advisers (radcowie prawni), published by the National Chamber of Legal Advisers over the lists kept by the nineteen regional chambers. It records entry on the list and shows whether a person is currently practising, which is a separate question from being entered.

item.title: Register of Statutory Auditors
item.description: The Polish register of statutory auditors, kept by the National Council of Statutory Auditors. It records individual auditors entitled to carry out statutory audits; audit firms are kept on a separate list by the same chamber.

item.title: List of Tax Advisers
item.description: The official list of Polish tax advisers, published by the National Chamber of Tax Advisers. Entry on the list is a statutory condition of performing tax advisory activities, and performing them without entitlement is punishable by a fine.

item.title: eSearch plus
item.description: eSearch plus is the European Union Intellectual Property Office’s public search application over its own registers of EU trade marks and EU designs. Results are presented under separate tabs for trade marks, designs, owners and representatives.

item.title: TMview
item.description: TMview is the search portal of the European Union Intellectual Property Network that searches trade mark applications and registrations held by participating offices — national offices in the EU, the EUIPO, and offices outside the EU. It aggregates data supplied by those offices and is not itself a trade mark register.

item.title: DesignView
item.description: DesignView is the design search portal of the European Union Intellectual Property Network. The office describes it as providing access to its own database of registered designs together with the databases of other national registries, so it aggregates data from participating offices rather than constituting a register.

item.title: European Database on Medical Devices (EUDAMED)
item.description: EUDAMED is the European database on medical devices established by the medical devices and in vitro diagnostic regulations. It holds registrations of economic operators, devices and certificates, and its first four modules became mandatory on 28 May 2026.

item.title: ECHA CHEM
item.description: ECHA CHEM is the European Chemicals Agency’s platform for information on substances placed on the EU market. It publishes information from REACH registration dossiers filed with the agency, together with classification and labelling entries and cross-references to other EU regulatory regimes.

item.title: Entities subject to an exclusion decision or a settlement agreement
item.description: The European Investment Bank publishes the entities currently subject to an exclusion decision or a settlement agreement under its exclusion policy. Each entry names the entity, its country of incorporation, the nature and validity period of the decision, and the type of proceedings.

item.title: Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS)
item.description: CTIS is the European system through which clinical trials in the EU and EEA are applied for, assessed and published. Its public website carries the trial information the Clinical Trials Regulation requires to be disclosed; the authorisation decisions themselves are taken by the member states concerned.

item.title: GIview
item.description: GIview is the search portal for geographical indications protected in the European Union. Responsibility for the underlying registers is split: the European Commission registers geographical indications for agricultural products, wines and spirit drinks, while the EU Intellectual Property Office is responsible for those covering craft and industrial products.

item.title: EU Sanctions Map
item.description: The EU Sanctions Map presents the European Union’s restrictive-measures regimes and the legal acts that constitute them, so a reader can see which measures exist and where they come from. It indexes regimes rather than listing designated persons, and its operator states that only the acts published in the Official Journal are authentic.

item.title: Consolidated list of persons, groups and entities subject to EU financial sanctions
item.description: The consolidated list brings together the natural and legal persons, groups and entities subject to EU financial sanctions. The Commission manages and updates it, and it reflects the officially adopted texts published in the Official Journal of the European Union.

item.title: EU Pesticides Database
item.description: The EU Pesticides Database brings together active substance approvals, plant protection product authorisations and maximum residue levels under EU plant-protection law. Its operator states that it is provided for information only and has no legal value, and that the official information is published in the Official Journal of the European Union.

item.title: General Authorisation Database (GADB)
item.description: The Union database of notifications from providers of electronic communications networks and services, established by BEREC under the European Electronic Communications Code. It aggregates the notifications made to national regulators under the general authorisation regime; it does not replace them and it is not a licence register.

item.title: SOS Business Entity Search
item.description: SOS Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Indiana Secretary of State, Business Services Division. Search fields: Per the IN.gov mobile services page: a "Full Name" or "Partial Name" search of a business entity. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Mississippi Secretary of State — Business Services & External Affairs (Business Services Division). Coverage: The corporations database covers registered business entities generally. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Arizona Business Center
item.description: Arizona Business Center is the state business-entity register operated by the Arizona Corporation Commission. Search-form labels present in the live application include "Business Name", "Business ID", "Entity Name", "Principal Name", "Statutory Agent Name" and "Trade Name". Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Entity Search
item.description: Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Michigan Department of Licensing and Regulatory Affairs (LARA), Corporations, Securities & Commercial Licensing Bureau, Corporations Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Services Online Filings Portal
item.description: Business Services Online Filings Portal is the state business-entity register operated by the New Mexico Secretary of State, Business Services Division. Coverage: The Secretary of State homepage states the portal can be used to "search for a registered business, fictitious name or trademark". Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Corporations Division of the Office of the Georgia Secretary of State. It covers domestic and foreign entities registered with the division. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Missouri Secretary of State — Corporations Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Entities Search
item.description: Business Entities Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Oklahoma Secretary of State — Business Records Department. Coverage: Per the Business Records Department page: "corporations, limited partnerships, limited liability companies, limited liability partnerships, partnership fictitious names, trade names and trademarks." Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Business Name Search
item.description: Business Name Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Pennsylvania Department of State, Bureau of Corporations and Charitable Organizations. Search fields: Business name and entity/file number. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Vermont Secretary of State, Business Services Division. It covers business entities registered with the Business Services Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Entities Online
item.description: Business Entities Online is the state business-entity register operated by the South Carolina Secretary of State's Office, Business Filings Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Government Records Inquiry System
item.description: Government Records Inquiry System is the state business-entity register operated by the Alabama Secretary of State — Business Services, Business Entities Division. Coverage: The Secretary of State states: "The Business Entity Division operates as a depository for records of domestic entities and foreign entities that have qualified to transact business in Alabama." Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: German Company Register
item.description: Unternehmensregister is the German central platform on which company data that must be published is brought together and made electronically retrievable. It carries register information transmitted from the commercial, cooperative, partnership and company registers, together with accounts and capital-market disclosures, and is constituted for that purpose by the Commercial Code.

item.title: Transparency Register
item.description: Transparenzregister is the German register of beneficial owners, established by the Money Laundering Act. Entities subject to the Act report the natural persons who ultimately own or control them, and the register records those persons rather than the entities themselves.

item.title: DPMAregister
item.description: DPMAregister is the official register and publication database of the German Patent and Trade Mark Office. It carries the office’s registers for patents, utility models, topographies and supplementary protection certificates, for trade marks and geographical indications, and for designs, each with its own search interface.

item.title: Insolvency Announcements
item.description: Insolvenzbekanntmachungen is the German portal on which the insolvency courts make the announcements required by the Insolvency Code. Publication there is the statutory public announcement of a proceeding; the proceeding itself is conducted and recorded by the court.

item.title: The register of the Nursing and Midwifery Council
item.description: The NMC Register is the statutory register of nurses, midwives and nursing associates maintained by the Nursing and Midwifery Council. A search returns whether a named professional is currently registered, whether their registration carries restrictions, and whether they have been suspended or removed.

item.title: The General Dental Council Registers
item.description: The GDC Registers are the statutory registers of dentists and dental care professionals maintained by the General Dental Council. They cover the dentists register, the dental care professionals register, specialist lists, temporary and visiting practitioners, and are searchable by name, town or registration number.

item.title: The Register of the Health and Care Professions Council
item.description: The HCPC Register is the statutory register of fifteen regulated health and care professions maintained by the Health and Care Professions Council, from paramedics and physiotherapists to practitioner psychologists and radiographers. It is searched by surname or registration number within a chosen profession.

item.title: Food hygiene ratings
item.description: Food hygiene ratings is the Food Standards Agency service publishing hygiene inspection outcomes for food businesses across the United Kingdom. It carries the 0-to-5 Food Hygiene Rating Scheme results for England, Northern Ireland and Wales alongside the pass or improvement-required outcomes of the separate Scottish scheme.

item.title: Scottish Charity Register
item.description: The Scottish Charity Register is the statutory register of Scottish charities kept by the Office of the Scottish Charity Regulator. It records each charity’s registered number, purposes, principal contact, accounts and the local authority areas in which it operates.

item.title: Register of Charities
item.description: The Register of Charities for Northern Ireland is kept by the Charity Commission for Northern Ireland and records charities registered under Northern Ireland charity law. It is the separate Northern Ireland counterpart to the England and Wales and Scottish charity registers.

item.title: Register of Insolvencies
item.description: The Register of Insolvencies is the public record of Scottish personal and corporate insolvency kept by the Accountant in Bankruptcy. It records sequestrations, protected trust deeds, trust deed adverts and moratoriums under Scotland’s own insolvency law.

item.title: Individual Voluntary Arrangement Register
item.description: The Individual Voluntary Arrangement Register for Northern Ireland is the public record of individual voluntary arrangements maintained by the Insolvency Service within the Department for the Economy. It is the Northern Ireland counterpart to the individual insolvency registers kept separately in Great Britain.

item.title: Find an independent healthcare provider or service
item.description: Healthcare Improvement Scotland publishes a searchable directory of the independent healthcare services it regulates in Scotland, covering independent clinics, hospitals, hospices and independent medical agencies. Each service page carries what the service is regulated to provide together with its inspection reports.

item.title: Care Inspectorate
item.description: The Care Inspectorate registers and inspects care services in Scotland and publishes the services it regulates together with their inspection grades. It is the Scottish counterpart for social care that Healthcare Improvement Scotland is for independent healthcare.

item.title: Care Inspectorate Wales
item.description: Care Inspectorate Wales registers and inspects care and childcare services in Wales on behalf of the Welsh Ministers, and publishes a directory of the registered services it regulates alongside their inspection reports.

item.title: Register
item.description: The Regulation and Quality Improvement Authority publishes the register of health and social care services it regulates in Northern Ireland as downloadable service lists, covering adult placement agencies, day care settings, domiciliary care agencies, independent clinics and other registered service types.

item.title: Register of Charities
item.description: The Register of Charities for England and Wales is kept by the Charity Commission and records registered charities together with their purposes, trustees, reported income and expenditure, filing history and any regulatory action taken against them. A full register extract is published for download.

item.title: Individual Insolvency Register
item.description: The Individual Insolvency Register is the public record of personal insolvency in England and Wales, published by the Insolvency Service. It combines the individual insolvency, bankruptcy restrictions and debt relief restrictions registers, covering bankruptcy orders, debt relief orders and individual voluntary arrangements.

item.title: Solicitors Register
item.description: The Solicitors Register is the public record of solicitors and law firms regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority in England and Wales. It records where a solicitor works, which firms are regulated, firms that have been closed down, and people prohibited from practising.

item.title: The Barristers’ Register
item.description: The Barristers’ Register is the public record kept by the Bar Standards Board of barristers authorised to practise in England and Wales, together with a separate view of disbarred or unregistered barristers carrying a current disciplinary finding.

item.title: Find a Tender service
item.description: Find a Tender is the United Kingdom government service publishing public sector procurement notices across the whole procurement lifecycle, from pipeline and planning through tender, award, contract details, change, performance and termination. Notices from one procurement are linked by a shared Open Contracting identifier.

item.title: Contracts Finder
item.description: Contracts Finder publishes lower-value public sector procurement notices and awarded contract records for contracting authorities within the extent of the Public Contracts Regulations 2015. It covers England together with reserved authorities in Wales and Northern Ireland, and does not extend to Scotland.

item.title: Public Contracts Scotland
item.description: Public Contracts Scotland is the national advertising portal for Scottish public sector procurement, publishing contract notices and awards from Scottish public bodies. It is the Scottish counterpart to the procurement notice services operated elsewhere in the United Kingdom.

item.title: Sell2Wales
item.description: Sell2Wales publishes public sector contract opportunities in Wales, together with buyer profiles, contract results and pipeline notices. It is operated by the Welsh Government as the Welsh counterpart to the other United Kingdom procurement notice services.

item.title: Register of disqualified company directors
item.description: The register of disqualified company directors records people who are banned from acting as a company director or being involved in forming or running a company. It is published by Companies House as a search distinct from the company register, and the disqualifications themselves are made by courts and other bodies rather than by Companies House.

item.title: National Business Register
item.description: Registre national des entreprises is the French national business register instituted by the Commercial Code and kept by the Institut national de la propriété industrielle. Since 2023 it records every business operating in France, whatever its legal form, replacing several separate registers that previously covered traders, craftspeople and agricultural businesses.

item.title: Sirene business identification register
item.description: Répertoire Sirene is the French identification register kept by the national statistics institute, which assigns the SIREN number to a business and the SIRET number to each of its establishments. It identifies and describes businesses and their establishments; it does not constitute their legal existence.

item.title: Official Bulletin of Civil and Commercial Announcements
item.description: BODACC is the French official bulletin that gives publicity to acts recorded in the national business register. It publishes registrations, modifications, transfers, removals, insolvency and conciliation proceedings and notices that company accounts have been filed, together with certain civil announcements.

item.title: Central Mercantile Register
item.description: Registro Mercantil Central is the Spanish central mercantile registry institution, dependent on the justice ministry. It issues and reserves company names, keeps the central archive of registered names, and centralises for publicity purposes the data it receives from the provincial mercantile registries, which are the registries where companies are actually registered.

item.title: Public Insolvency Register
item.description: Registro Público Concursal is the Spanish public insolvency register, which gives publicity to the principal decisions issued in insolvency proceedings declared in Spain or producing effects there. It is organised in sections covering insolvency edicts, the registration publicity of insolvency decisions, and out-of-court settlement agreements.

item.title: Spanish Patent and Trademark Office
item.description: The Oficina Española de Patentes y Marcas is the Spanish industrial property office, an autonomous body of the General State Administration that grants patents, utility models, trade marks, trade names and industrial designs. Its registers are searchable through free public databases on its consultation hosts.

item.title: National Securities Market Commission
item.description: The Comisión Nacional del Mercado de Valores is the Spanish securities market supervisor. It keeps the official registers of authorised investment firms, collective investment schemes and their managers, venture capital entities, securitisation funds and financial advisers, together with the regulated information filed by listed issuers.

item.title: Italian industrial property titles database
item.description: Banca dati UIBM is the searchable database of Italian industrial property titles published by the Italian Patent and Trademark Office within the enterprise ministry. It covers applications and granted titles for trade marks, patents and designs, which are three distinct rights recorded in one search system.

item.title: Legal Advertising
item.description: Piattaforma per la pubblicità a valore legale is the Italian platform on which public procurement notices are published with legal effect, operated by the national anti-corruption authority. Since January 2024 it has replaced the special public-contracts series of the official gazette for national procurement publication, and the legal effects of a published notice run from its publication there.

item.title: National Single Register of the Third Sector
item.description: The Registro unico nazionale del Terzo settore is the Italian register of third sector entities, established at the Ministry of Labour and Social Policies under the Third Sector Code. Registration confers the status of third sector entity and, where applicable, the specific statuses of voluntary organisation, social promotion association, philanthropic entity or associative network.

item.title: Canadian Patents Database
item.description: Canadian Patents Database is the federal patent register published by the Canadian Intellectual Property Office. It exposes Canadian patent applications and granted patents, with bibliographic data, claims and legal status, searchable without an account.

item.title: MRAS Canadian Business Registry
item.description: MRAS Canadian Business Registry is a federal search interface that queries participating provincial, territorial and federal corporate registers through the Multi-Jurisdictional Registry Access Service. It is a cross-registry lookup layer operated by Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada, not itself a register of record.

item.title: SEDAR+
item.description: SEDAR+ is the national filing and disclosure system of the Canadian Securities Administrators, carrying public securities filings by reporting issuers together with cease trade orders and disciplined lists. It is operated jointly by the provincial and territorial securities regulators rather than by a federal agency.

item.title: Ontario Business Registry
item.description: Ontario Business Registry is the provincial register of Ontario corporations, not-for-profit corporations and registered business names, operated by the Ministry of Public and Business Service Delivery and Procurement. Basic entity information is searchable at no charge, while profile reports, certificates and document copies are priced products.

item.title: Enterprise register
item.description: The Quebec enterprise register is the provincial register of enterprises maintained by the Registraire des entreprises, recording enterprises that carry on business in Quebec together with the persons involved in their administration and operation. Québec publishes the register as public information and offers both a simple and an advanced search.

item.title: Licence holders register
item.description: The licence holders register of the Régie du bâtiment du Québec records contractors and owner-builders licensed to carry out construction work in Quebec. The Régie directs the public to the register to check a contractor or a licence number before engaging them.

item.title: BC Registry Services
item.description: BC Registry Services administers the British Columbia registers of businesses, not-for-profit societies, cooperative associations and financial institutions, and states that the records it maintains are public records. Searches and certificates are supplied through its search unit and the BC OnLine service.

item.title: Companies Office
item.description: The Manitoba Companies Office maintains the provincial registers of corporations, business names, trade names and limited partnerships within the Consumer Protection Division. Manitoba states that the public may search the registry to establish who is behind a trade name and to obtain a list of officers and directors.

item.title: Registry of Joint Stock Companies
item.description: The Registry of Joint Stock Companies is the Nova Scotia register of sole proprietorships, partnerships, companies, societies, co-operatives and business names. Nova Scotia publishes a search over the information those entities are required by law to file, including addresses, partners, directors and officers.

item.title: Companies and Deeds Online
item.description: Companies and Deeds Online is the Newfoundland and Labrador registry service covering companies, co-operatives, condominiums, deeds, mechanics liens and lobbyists. It is published by the provincial government as a single online entry point to those separate registers.

item.title: Corporate Registry
item.description: The Saskatchewan Corporate Registry is the provincial register of business entities, delivered under agreement by Information Services Corporation rather than directly by a government office. The registry remains statutory while the service that fronts it is operated commercially and presents a sign-in wall.

item.title: Corporate Registries
item.description: Corporate Registries is the Northwest Territories register of territorial incorporations, extra-territorial registrations, societies, co-operative associations, partnerships and business names, administered by the territorial Department of Justice. Basic entity information is available at no charge through the Corporate Registries Online System.

item.title: Legal Registries Division
item.description: The Legal Registries Division of the Nunavut Department of Justice administers the territory’s corporate registries together with its personal property registry, land titles office and securities office. Nunavut states that almost all records are available to the public to view or obtain copies.

item.title: Canadian Trademarks Database
item.description: Canadian Trademarks Database is the federal trademark register published by the Canadian Intellectual Property Office. It carries applied-for and registered Canadian trademarks together with certification marks, distinguishing guises, geographical indications and plant breeders’ rights denominations, searchable by mark, owner, application or registration number and international registration number.

item.title: CanadaBuys
item.description: CanadaBuys is the Government of Canada procurement service publishing federal tender notices, award notices and contract history. It is the single official point of access for doing business with the Government of Canada and the broader Canadian public sector.

item.title: APRA Registers
item.description: APRA Registers is the national register operated by the Australian Prudential Regulation Authority. The registers are published as browsable lists rather than a search application.

item.title: Australian Trade Mark Search
item.description: Australian Trade Mark Search is the national register operated by IP Australia. It records registered and pending Australian trade marks. The operator lists searchable dimensions as Word, Phrase, Image, Owner, and Goods and services.

item.title: Victorian Incorporated Associations Public Register
item.description: Victorian Incorporated Associations Public Register is the state register operated by Consumer Affairs Victoria. It records incorporated associations registered in Victoria under the Associations Incorporation Reform Act 2012. Search by incorporated association name, by registration number, or by browsing associations pending cancellation.

item.title: AssociationsOnline
item.description: AssociationsOnline is the state register operated by the Department of Local Government, Industry Regulation and Safety (LGIRS) — Consumer Protection. It records associations incorporated in Western Australia under the Associations Incorporation Act 2015. Search fields: Free-text search by association name or by IARN (Incorporated Association Registration Number). The results grid returns four columns, confirmed from the live table headers: Association Name, Number, Status, Date Incorporated.

item.title: Licensing NT Public Register
item.description: Licensing NT Public Register is the territory register operated by the Northern Territory Government. It records holders of business and professional licences and registrations issued under nine Northern Territory licensing schemes. Licence Number; Licence Scheme (optional dropdown of the nine schemes — leaving it blank searches across all); Business Name with Exact Name / Partial Name / Sounds Like matching; Licensee Name with the same three matching modes; a checkbox "Only Display Active Licences and Registrations" (ticked by default); and Suburb or Postcode.

item.title: QBCC Licensee Register
item.description: QBCC Licensee Register is the state register operated by the Queensland Building and Construction Commission. It records holders of QBCC building and construction licences in Queensland — both individuals and companies, across contractor, builder, trade contractor, nominee supervisor and site supervisor licence classes. A licensee is looked up by name or by licence number — QBCC states "if you have a person's licence number or name, you can look them up in our [licensee register]".

item.title: WA Online Licence Search
item.description: WA Online Licence Search is the state register operated by the Department of Local Government, Industry Regulation and Safety. It records holders of occupational licences, registrations, permits, certificates and accreditations issued under Western Australian law by three divisions of the department. Search fields: A licence type must be selected first; the form then exposes, per type, company/business or family name, first name, location or post code, a search-all-WA option, date of birth (for individual credentials such as High Risk Work Licence and Construction Induction Training Card), and charity category for the Charity type. The application also carries a licence-number lookup path. Records returned include the licensee or entity name, licence number, licence type and sub-type (individual, body corporate/company, partnership), licence status, expiry date, entity type, trading names where held, and a business locality.

item.title: Check a charity or association
item.description: Check a charity or association is the state register operated by the Office of Fair Trading, Department of Justice (Queensland). It records associations incorporated in Queensland under the Associations Incorporation Act 1981 (Qld), and charities authorised to fundraise in Queensland under the Collections Act 1966 (Qld). Search fields: Organisation Number (e.g. IA or CH prefixed numbers, partial matches accepted), Organisation Name, and Organisation Postcode — singly or in combination.

item.title: Incorporated Associations Search
item.description: Incorporated Associations Search is the state register operated by Consumer and Business Services. It records incorporated associations registered in South Australia under the Associations Incorporation Act 1985 (SA), administered by Consumer and Business Services. Two search modes are offered, presented as tabs labelled "By Name / Reg No" and "By Public Officer".

item.title: ACT Incorporated Associations Public Register
item.description: ACT Incorporated Associations Public Register is the territory register operated by Access Canberra, City and Environment Directorate, ACT Government. It records associations incorporated in the ACT under the Associations Incorporation Act 1991. Five fields are displayed for every record: Association number (format A#####, e.g. A00266), Association name, Status, Date of incorporation and Date of cessation.

item.title: Tasmanian Licensed Occupations Search
item.description: Tasmanian Licensed Occupations Search is the state register operated by Consumer, Building and Occupational Services (CBOS), Department of Justice, Tasmania. It records current holders of Tasmanian occupational licences administered by CBOS, in five licence areas as listed by the search application: "Electrical, Plumbing, Gas Fitting and Automotive Gas Fitting", "Building Services Provider", "Motor Vehicle Trader", "Security and Investigation", and "Conveyancer". The public first chooses a licence area; for Building Services Provider a further licence-type step appears with the options "Company", "Municipal Council" and "Individual".

item.title: Administrative Register of Economic Subjects
item.description: ARES is the Czech Ministry of Finance information system that brings together data on economic subjects held in other registers, including the public register kept by the courts, the trade licensing register and the statistical register. It resolves a Czech entity to its identification number and shows what each source register records, without constituting any of that data itself.

item.title: Insolvency Register
item.description: Insolvenční rejstřík is the Czech public insolvency register kept under the Insolvency Act, publishing insolvency proceedings, the decisions issued in them and the associated case files. Publication in the register is how insolvency decisions are made publicly effective in the Czech Republic.

item.title: Register of Beneficial Owners
item.description: Evidence skutečných majitelů is the Czech register of beneficial owners, kept under Act No. 37/2021 Coll. and administered by the Ministry of Justice. On 17 December 2025 the Ministry withdrew public access to it, and inspection is now limited to registering persons, public authorities, obliged entities under the anti-money-laundering act and other legally entitled applicants.

item.title: National Court Register
item.description: Krajowy Rejestr Sądowy is the Polish National Court Register, kept by the registry courts under the Act of 20 August 1997. It comprises the register of entrepreneurs — commercial companies, cooperatives, state enterprises and branches of foreign entrepreneurs — together with the register of associations, other social and professional organisations, foundations and public healthcare institutions.

item.title: National Register of Debtors
item.description: Krajowy Rejestr Zadłużonych is the Polish register of debtors, kept by the Minister of Justice under the Act of 6 December 2018. It discloses restructuring and bankruptcy proceedings, proceedings on a ban from conducting business activity, enforcement discontinued as ineffective, and maintenance arrears older than three months.

item.title: Business Registers Interconnection System (BRIS)
item.description: BRIS is the European system that interconnects the business registers of the EU member states, reached through the “Find a company” service on the European e-Justice Portal. It gathers company information from the national registers in real time; the registers themselves remain with the member states.

item.title: VAT Information Exchange System (VIES)
item.description: VIES is the European Commission service for checking whether a VAT identification number issued by a member state is valid. Each check is run against that member state’s own national VAT database; there is no EU-level VAT database behind it.

item.title: Tenders Electronic Daily (TED)
item.description: TED is the online supplement to the Official Journal of the European Union for public procurement. Contracting authorities across the EU and the European Economic Area publish their procurement notices there, and the notices are searchable without charge.

item.title: Transparency Register
item.description: The Transparency Register lists interest representatives who seek to influence EU policy and decision-making. It is operated jointly by the European Parliament, the Council of the European Union and the European Commission under a 2021 interinstitutional agreement, and registrants publish a profile of their lobbying and advocacy activity.

item.title: List of registered or certified credit rating agencies
item.description: ESMA publishes the list of credit rating agencies registered or certified under the Credit Rating Agencies Regulation. ESMA is the direct supervisor of credit rating agencies in the European Union, so the registration decisions behind this list are its own rather than compiled from national authorities.

item.title: Credit institutions register
item.description: The European Banking Authority publishes a register of credit institutions authorised in the European Economic Area. The authorisations themselves are granted by national authorities; the EBA assembles their notifications into one European view.

item.title: Register of payment and electronic money institutions under PSD2
item.description: The European Banking Authority publishes a central register of payment institutions and electronic money institutions authorised or registered under the second Payment Services Directive. The authorisations are granted by national authorities, which supply the information the register contains.

item.title: Register of Insurance Undertakings
item.description: The European Insurance and Occupational Pensions Authority publishes a register of insurance undertakings authorised in the European Economic Area. It represents information supplied by the national supervisory authorities and is updated weekly.

item.title: Early Detection and Exclusion System (EDES) database
item.description: The European Commission publishes the list of persons and entities excluded from participating in EU-funded award procedures, or subject to a financial penalty, under the Early Detection and Exclusion System. Publication is provided for by the Financial Regulation and is reserved for the most severe cases.

item.title: OpenCorporates
item.description: Open legal-entity database aggregating company records sourced from more than 140 official government registries.

item.title: Trustpilot
item.description: Open consumer review platform where any customer can publish a rating of a business, with a free tier for collecting reviews.

item.title: Yelp for Business
item.description: Local business listing and consumer review platform; claiming a basic business page is free, with paid advertising available.

item.title: Capterra
item.description: Software comparison directory listing business applications by category with verified user reviews and feature breakdowns.

item.title: Software Advice
item.description: Software advisory and comparison directory pairing category listings with verified user reviews and a free recommendation service.

item.title: AlternativeTo
item.description: Crowd-sourced catalogue of software alternatives, ranking roughly 150,000 applications by user opinion.

item.title: Clutch
item.description: B2B service-provider directory covering development, design and marketing firms, built around verified client interviews.

item.title: DesignRush
item.description: Agency directory and awards platform listing design, development and marketing firms with star-rated client feedback.

item.title: Crunchbase
item.description: Private-market intelligence platform profiling companies, investors and people, with a public company-profile submission route.

item.title: Product Hunt
item.description: Daily launch platform where new software products are posted and ranked by community upvotes and comments.

item.title: Wellfound
item.description: Startup talent marketplace hosting company profiles for more than 27,000 startups, with free unlimited job posting.

item.title: Shopify App Store
item.description: Official marketplace of applications extending Shopify stores, with merchant star ratings and review counts on every listing.

item.title: Salesforce AppExchange (AgentExchange)
item.description: Salesforce enterprise application marketplace; the storefront now presents itself under the AgentExchange name.

item.title: HubSpot App Marketplace
item.description: Official HubSpot marketplace listing integrations, workflows and templates that connect to the HubSpot platform.

item.title: GitHub Marketplace
item.description: GitHub marketplace cataloguing Apps and Actions across continuous integration, code quality, deployment and security.

item.title: WordPress Plugin Directory
item.description: Official directory of free and open-source WordPress plugins, with user ratings and install counts on every entry.

item.title: Add-ons for Firefox
item.description: Mozilla-operated catalogue distributing Firefox extensions, themes, dictionaries and language packs with user star ratings.

item.title: Python Package Index (PyPI)
item.description: Official package repository for the Python language, maintained by the Python Software Foundation.

item.title: RubyGems.org
item.description: Package host for the Ruby language, operated by Ruby Central and the RubyGems team.

item.title: Packagist.org
item.description: Main Composer repository, aggregating public PHP packages for dependency installation.

item.title: crates.io
item.description: Official package registry for the Rust language, operated by the Rust Foundation.

item.title: NuGet Gallery
item.description: Central package repository for the .NET ecosystem, operated by Microsoft.

item.title: Maven Central
item.description: Central repository of open-source components for the Java and JVM ecosystem, operated by Sonatype.

item.title: pub.dev
item.description: Official package repository for Dart and Flutter applications, supported by Google.

item.title: Hex
item.description: Package manager for the Erlang ecosystem, serving Elixir, Erlang and Gleam projects.

item.title: Docker Hub
item.description: Container image library for discovering and publishing containerised applications.

item.title: Flathub
item.description: Cross-distribution application store for Linux, distributing software as Flatpak packages.

item.title: Snap Store
item.description: Application store for Linux operated by Canonical, distributing software packaged as snaps.

item.title: F-Droid
item.description: Android application catalogue restricted to free and open-source software.

item.title: Visual Studio Marketplace
item.description: Microsoft marketplace distributing extensions for the Visual Studio family of products.

item.title: JetBrains Marketplace
item.description: Plugin marketplace for JetBrains integrated development environments.

item.title: Atlassian Marketplace
item.description: Marketplace of applications extending Atlassian products, with user ratings on each listing.

item.title: WooCommerce extensions
item.description: Marketplace of extensions, themes and services for the WooCommerce ecommerce platform, operated by Automattic.

item.title: Drupal Modules
item.description: Directory of contributed modules extending Drupal, governed by the non-profit Drupal Association.

item.title: Joomla! Extensions Directory
item.description: Official catalogue of Joomla extensions, organised by category with user ratings and reviews.

item.title: GetApp
item.description: Business software comparison directory with verified user reviews, operated by Nubera eBusiness.

item.title: PeerSpot
item.description: Enterprise technology review platform that verifies every reviewer as a recent user of the product.

item.title: Slashdot Software Directory
item.description: Business software comparison directory organised by category, with user ratings on each product.

item.title: SourceForge
item.description: Open-source project host and business software comparison platform with user reviews.

item.title: SaaSHub
item.description: Independent software marketplace for discovering and comparing alternatives, with community-run expert assessments.

item.title: LibHunt
item.description: Catalogue of open-source projects ranked by mentions across developer communities.

item.title: Foursquare Places
item.description: Point-of-interest dataset covering business locations across more than 200 countries, with an open-source tier.

item.title: Hugging Face
item.description: Collaboration platform hosting machine-learning models, datasets and demo applications.

item.title: Kaggle Datasets
item.description: Catalogue of open datasets for artificial-intelligence and research use, operated by Kaggle under Google.

item.title: Ollama Library
item.description: Public catalogue of large language models packaged for local execution through Ollama.

item.title: Open Collective
item.description: Transparent fund-management platform where collectives and organisations publish their finances publicly.

item.title: The Legal 500
item.description: Legal market guide ranking law firms and practitioners by practice area, published by Legalease since 1987.

item.title: Chambers and Partners
item.description: Legal research publisher ranking firms and lawyers across regional and specialist guides, based on interviews and firm submissions.

item.title: PR Newswire
item.description: Press release distribution service owned by Cision, delivering company announcements to media outlets and newsrooms.

item.title: npm
item.description: Public registry of JavaScript packages and their metadata, installed through the npm command-line client; publishing a public package costs nothing and requires an npm account.

item.title: Google Business Profile
item.description: Google’s free tool for managing how a business appears in Google Search and Maps, covering opening hours, contact details, location, photos and customer reviews once the profile has been verified.

item.title: Swift Package Index
item.description: Open-source index of Swift packages that support Swift Package Manager, where a package enters the index by being submitted to the project’s public package-list repository and meeting a published set of technical requirements.

item.title: G2
item.description: Software review and product-profile platform run by G2.com, Inc., where a vendor submits a product for a research-team eligibility check and then claims the resulting profile, and each review is moderated by a person before it is published.

item.title: Better Business Bureau
item.description: North American non-profit network publishing business profiles, consumer complaints and a paid accreditation programme.

item.title: USPTO Trademark Search
item.description: Federal trademark database of United States registrations and applications, searchable free of charge.

item.title: EDGAR
item.description: Public filing system operated by the US Securities and Exchange Commission, holding registration statements, prospectuses and the periodic reports filed by companies that carry a federal disclosure obligation.

item.title: BrokerCheck
item.description: Free FINRA tool for researching the registration history, qualifications and disclosure events of US brokerage firms, investment adviser firms and the individuals registered with them.

item.title: USAspending.gov
item.description: Federal award transparency database operated by the Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service, publishing transaction-level contracts, grants, loans and direct payments reported by agencies under the DATA Act, with recipient profiles keyed by UEI.

item.title: SAM.gov Entity Information
item.description: Federal award registration record operated by GSA, holding the registrations organisations must complete to bid for federal contracts or receive federal assistance, including the Unique Entity ID and the Responsibility/Qualification records formerly published as FAPIIS.

item.title: FDIC BankFind Suite
item.description: Authoritative record of every FDIC-insured depository institution, keyed by FDIC certificate number, covering insurance status, branch offices, structure changes and filed financial reports.

item.title: OCC Financial Institution Search
item.description: Search over the national banks and federal savings associations chartered by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, covering the charter roster, Community Reinvestment Act evaluations, enforcement actions and corporate applications.

item.title: Investment Adviser Public Disclosure
item.description: SEC disclosure system for investment advisers, publishing Form ADV filings by SEC- and state-registered adviser firms, their representatives, and Exempt Reporting Advisers including private fund managers.

item.title: FinCEN MSB Registrant Search
item.description: List of businesses that have filed a Registration of Money Services Business with FinCEN under the Bank Secrecy Act, covering money transmitters, cheque cashers, currency dealers and comparable providers.

item.title: NFA BASIC
item.description: Background Affiliation Status Information Center published by the National Futures Association, showing CFTC registration status, NFA membership and regulatory actions for derivatives firms, commodity pool operators, trading advisers and associated individuals.

item.title: NPPES NPI Registry
item.description: Public enumeration of every assigned National Provider Identifier, covering individual practitioners and organisational healthcare providers, with taxonomy codes and practice addresses as supplied by the provider.

item.title: FDA Establishment Registration and Device Listing
item.description: Registry of medical device establishments registered with the FDA Center for Devices and Radiological Health, together with the devices each has listed, searchable by establishment, owner or operator, product code or proprietary name.

item.title: Tax Exempt Organization Search
item.description: IRS search over five tax-exemption datasets, covering organisations eligible to receive deductible contributions, automatic revocations, filed Form 990 series returns, Form 990-N filings and determination letters.

item.title: Patent Public Search
item.description: USPTO search over granted US patents and published applications, providing full document text and images for the public patent record.

item.title: DMCA Designated Agent Directory
item.description: Copyright Office directory of agents designated by online service providers to receive copyright infringement notifications, resolving a platform to a legal entity name and a service-of-process address.

item.title: TTB List of Permittees
item.description: Published lists of holders of federal alcohol basic permits, released by the Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau as frequently requested FOIA records covering producers, wholesalers and importers.

item.title: Permitted Customs Brokers Listing
item.description: Customs and Border Protection list of customs brokers holding a federal permit to transact customs business, published by port with company contact details.

item.title: Federal Maritime Commission Ocean Transportation Intermediary List
item.description: Federal Maritime Commission lists of licensed ocean freight forwarders and non-vessel-operating common carriers that have met the Commission’s licensing, financial responsibility and tariff requirements.

item.title: FCC Universal Licensing System
item.description: Federal Communications Commission register of wireless radio licences and the applications behind them, keyed by call sign and FCC Registration Number, covering licensee name, radio service, status and expiry.

item.title: FCC Form 499 Filer Database
item.description: Registration records for providers required to file the Telecommunications Reporting Worksheet, giving the 499 Filer ID, the carrier’s legal name, its holding company and its designated agent for service of process.

item.title: FAA Aircraft Registry
item.description: The US civil aircraft register, published by the FAA Civil Aviation Registry, giving registration status, registered owner, manufacturer, model and airworthiness classification for each N-numbered aircraft.

item.title: MSHA Mine Data Retrieval System
item.description: Mine Safety and Health Administration register of every coal and metal or non-metal mine under its jurisdiction since 1970, keyed by Mine ID and linking each mine to its operator and controlling entity alongside inspection and enforcement records.

item.title: FSIS Meat, Poultry and Egg Product Inspection Directory
item.description: Directory of establishments holding a USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service grant of inspection, listing establishment number, activities carried out and the establishment’s commercial identifier.

item.title: SAM.gov Exclusions
item.description: Governmentwide record of parties excluded from federal contracts, subcontracts and federal assistance, listing firms and individuals debarred, suspended, proposed for debarment, declared ineligible or voluntarily excluded by any federal agency.

item.title: HHS OIG List of Excluded Individuals and Entities
item.description: List of individuals and organisations currently excluded from Medicare, Medicaid and all other federally funded health care programmes, maintained by the HHS Office of Inspector General under the Social Security Act.

item.title: CFTC Sanctions in Effect
item.description: Commodity Futures Trading Commission registers of registration and trading sanctions currently in force against named derivatives-market respondents, together with unpaid reparations awards, searchable by respondent name, alternative name and docket.

item.title: Drug Establishments Current Registration Site
item.description: Publication of currently registered human drug establishments maintained by the FDA Center for Drug Evaluation and Research, giving one row per registered site with its FDA Establishment Identifier, DUNS number and registered business operations.

item.title: CorpOnline
item.description: CorpOnline is the district business-entity register operated by the Government of the District of Columbia, Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection (DLCP), Corporations Division. Search by business name (Starts With / Contains, with an optional sounds-like/soundex method) or entity number, plus an advanced search including principal name and date range. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Registro Electrónico de Corporaciones y Entidades
item.description: Registro Electrónico de Corporaciones y Entidades is the territorial business-entity register operated by the Departamento de Estado de Puerto Rico, Registro de Corporaciones. It covers domestic and foreign corporations, limited liability companies, non-profit corporations and cooperative societies under Ley 164-2009. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Catalyst
item.description: Catalyst is the territorial business-entity register operated by the Government of the United States Virgin Islands, Office of the Lieutenant Governor, Division of Corporations and Trademarks. Search by item name or number with a Starts With / Contains operator, an Advanced mode, and a register selector ("-- Any register --", "Business Names", "Business Entities"). Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Business Records Search
item.description: Business Records Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Office of the Secretary of the State (Connecticut). Coverage: "This search covers all domestic (formed in Connecticut) and foreign (formed outside of Connecticut) entities on record." Trade names (DBAs), trade/service marks and UCC liens are searched through separate tools on the same portal, not through Business Records Search. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Corporate Name Search (ICRS)
item.description: Corporate Name Search (ICRS) is the state business-entity register operated by the Maine Department of the Secretary of State — Division of Corporations, UCC & Commissions. Search fields: Two input fields only: "Keyword from name to be searched" and "Charter number", plus the entity-category dropdown above. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Search for a Business Entity
item.description: Search for a Business Entity is the state business-entity register operated by the Secretary of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts — Corporations Division. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Records Service
item.description: Business Records Service is the state business-entity register operated by the New Jersey Department of the Treasury — Division of Revenue and Enterprise Services (DORES). Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Corporation and Business Entity Database
item.description: Corporation and Business Entity Database is the state business-entity register operated by the New York State Department of State — Division of Corporations. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Search for an entity within the RI Business Portal (CIMS)
item.description: Search for an entity within the RI Business Portal (CIMS) is the state business-entity register operated by the Rhode Island Department of State — Business Services Division. Coverage: The entity-name search is scoped on-page as "(Corp., LP, LLP, LLC, Non-resident Landlord)". Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Search for a Business Entity
item.description: Search for a Business Entity is the state business-entity register operated by the Delaware Department of State, Division of Corporations. Search fields: Two search fields only: Entity Name and File Number. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Sunbiz
item.description: Sunbiz is the state business-entity register operated by the Florida Department of State, Division of Corporations. It covers corporations (profit and non-profit), Limited Liability Companies, Limited Partnerships, foreign/out-of-state qualifications, and — unusually — Trademarks, all searchable in the same system. A live detail record returned the entity type label "Florida Profit Corporation". Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Business Entity Search
item.description: Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT). Search fields: Three search modes, verified on the live page: Business Name, Department ID, and Employer Identification Number (EIN). Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Registration search
item.description: Business Registration search is the state business-entity register operated by the North Carolina Department of the Secretary of State, Business Registration Division. Search fields: Four search targets: "Company By Name"; "Company by Secretary of State Identification Number (SOSID)"; "Company Officials"; "Registered Agents". Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Organization Search
item.description: Business Organization Search is the state business-entity register operated by the West Virginia Secretary of State. Wildcard matching is officially documented. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Database Search
item.description: Business Database Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Colorado Secretary of State — Business Division. It covers domestic and foreign corporations, LLCs, LPs, LLPs and nonprofit corporations, PLUS trade names and trademarks, all in one combined index. Quick search accepts 'business name, trademark, trade name, ID or document number'. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: SOSBiz
item.description: SOSBiz is the state business-entity register operated by the Idaho Secretary of State. It covers business entities plus trademarks and notaries, exposed as three distinct search screens on one platform: 'Business Search', 'Trademark Search' and 'Find A Notary'. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Filing Portal
item.description: Business Filing Portal is the state business-entity register operated by the Montana Secretary of State — Business Services Division. Search fields: 'Search by Name or Commission Number' and 'Search available business names'. Whether filed document images can be viewed free of charge is not stated on the official pages.

item.title: Business Search
item.description: Business Search is the state business-entity register operated by the California Secretary of State — Business Programs Division. It covers corporations, LLCs and limited partnerships, domestic and foreign-qualified. Search fields: Entity name and entity number, with filters for filing type, status and a filing-date range, plus a distinct officer/owner name search field. Filed document images are viewable without charge.

item.title: Hawaii Business Entity Search
item.description: Hawaii Business Entity Search is the state business-entity register operated by the State of Hawaii Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs — Business Registration Division (BREG). Named public services on the new portal: 'Business Name Search', 'Search and Buy', 'Entity List Builder', 'Manage' (for filing annual reports) and 'Request a Copy or Certified Copy'. Filed documents and certificates are ordered separately for a fee.

item.title: Business Name Search
item.description: Business Name Search is the state business-entity register operated by the Oregon Secretary of State — Corporation Division.
